sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong favourites against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season and arrive in poor form. This is a chance for the leaders to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their own recent defeat. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two strong sides—Bridgnorth looking to recover from back-to-back losses, while Eccleshall arrive in excellent recent form. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth, face Wednesfield Community at home; the visitors come off a win but remain inconsistent, while Casuals have won their last two. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter featuring two teams with solid recent records. At the bottom, winless Widnes Town visit Brereton Social in a fixture between struggling sides, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in another low-table clash. Market Drayton Town host New Mills—both seeking consistency after mixed recent form. Shawbury United, on a run of five consecutive defeats, are at home to improving Barnton. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath; Crewe picked up a win recently but remain near the bottom, while Allscott come off back-to-back victories. Wednesday evening sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture between two mid-table sides.
